# Every source the static QEMU build uses: sha256, file name, upstream URL.
# create-archive fetches each from the Nexus mirror first, then upstream, and
# checks it against the sha256; build_qemu.sh publishes them all next to the
# binary tarball (the sources of what is built here, and the musl release for
# its licence). The libslirp file is a GitLab-generated archive, which upstream
# does not keep byte-stable: our mirrored copy is the reference.
